description:
About the Scholarship

EU4M is the Erasmus Mundus master in mechatronic engineering coordinated from ENSMM Besançon with mobility through Spanish and German partner campuses. Scholarship rounds in recent cycles closed on 15 January, and the 2027 intake application window is already being promoted by the consortium.

OpportunityEU4M – Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Mechatronic Engineering
HostEU4M Consortium
LocationBesançon (multi-country mobility), France
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
Stipend€1,400/month (EMJM scholarship rate)
Application Deadline15 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

EU4M is the Erasmus Mundus master in mechatronic engineering coordinated from ENSMM Besançon with mobility through Spanish and German partner campuses. Scholarship rounds in recent cycles closed on 15 January, and the 2027 intake application window is already being promoted by the consortium.

Programme Highlights

  • Micro-engineering and mechatronics focus tied to the Besançon watchmaking-tech cluster
  • Mid-January scholarship deadline pattern across recent cycles
  • Mobility across French, Spanish and German partner universities
  • Graduates enter precision engineering, robotics and industrial automation

Who Should Apply

Mechanical, electrical and mechatronics engineering graduates are the core applicants, with English documentation per the consortium checklist.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance and travel support.

Deadline and How to Apply

Track the EU4M website for the 2027 application form and submit before the mid-January scholarship cut-off. Key deadline information: 15 January 2027 (scholarship round, expected); applications open for the 2027 intake.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About EU4M Consortium

The EU4M consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Mechatronic Engineering from Besançon with European partner universities, focusing on instrumentation, control and micro-engineering.

Official website: https://www.eu4m.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 15 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

  • A 12-Month Study Abroad Application Plan for Master's and PhD Applicants
